applies_to: XMem token-affinity engineering gate reporting and deterministic initialization

audit_finding.source_snapshot_verified: All 19 archived source files matched the hashes in setup.json; the setup digest matched completion.json.
audit_finding.scope_passed: Bit-identical zero-strength replay on fixed seq2/seq3 reads; all four attention layers; unchanged key/value and pointer inputs; finite adapter gradients; frozen SAM2 parameters and memory banks.
audit_finding.scope_not_passed: The receipt said passed=true, but the frozen protocol separately requires an adapter/optimizer/RNG save-resume equivalence check. The verifier did not perform that check. Treat the successful attempt as a partial engineering pass, not a complete gate.

corrections_before_any_efficacy_run.deterministic_initialization: The frozen seed was used for clip sampling but not explicitly for the randomly initialized affinity projections. The gate now applies a deterministic per-sequence adapter seed derived from the frozen seed and sequence number, records it in setup.json and completion.json, and has a regression test.
corrections_before_any_efficacy_run.frozen_model_mode: The adapter-training setup now calls model.eval() after freezing parameters, so SAM2 dropout remains disabled while gradients update only the adapter. This does not disable autograd.
corrections_before_any_efficacy_run.receipt_language: The gate receipt now reports status=partial_engineering_pass, protocol_complete=false, and lists the missing save/resume check. The existing passed field means only the checks implemented by the verifier passed.

next_required_checks: Rerun the short seq2/seq3 engineering probe with a new Drive output folder after the deterministic-initialization and frozen-mode corrections.
Implement and verify adapter, optimizer, and RNG save-resume equivalence using the actual training path.
Implement the training runner, matched frame-broadcast control, split/receipt validation, and atomic resume before any efficacy run.
Pass the complete code and real-checkpoint engineering gate before launching efficacy training.
scope: No efficacy training or full-propagation experiment is authorized by this amendment. The method, frozen clips, checkpoint, data, and scientific success rule are unchanged.
